result: In `sync_fifo_core`, replace the circular `mem[rd_ptr]` output selection with a parameterized shift-register queue that presents its oldest entry directly from slot zero, and shifts remaining entries on each accepted output transfer. Handle simultaneous pop/push—including a full queue—by appending the input at the post-pop occupancy; preserve empty capture timing, stall stability, reset behavior, explicit capacity and wrap semantics for all supported `WIDTH` and `DEPTH` values. Keep the top `sync_fifo` interface and its `// @latency 1` annotation unchanged; do not add a pipeline stage.
